description: Check a 10-digit NPI against the self-hosted HHS OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Returns matching exclusion records with source freshness and evidence IDs. A match is a screening lead, not final identity confirmation; verify it with HHS OIG.

npi.description: Exactly 10 digits; placeholder NPI 0000000000 is rejected.

name: leie_lookup_npi
